items.headline: Patent granted for flexible trade confirmations
items.summary: OneCore Global received a US patent for technology that lets commodity trading partners electronically confirm trades across differing data formats, reducing manual fax/email reconciliation workflows.

items.headline: Santander digitalizes Brazil trade finance via Komgo
items.summary: Banco Santander became the first Brazilian bank to digitalize trade finance processes using Geneva fintech Komgo's platform, as Brazil heads toward a record trade surplus.

items.headline: EMIR REFIT shifts focus to reporting quality
items.summary: With EMIR REFIT go-live complete, EU firms are now being pushed to prove derivatives reports are accurate and properly controlled, not just technically validated by trade repositories.

items.headline: Hormuz attacks and blank sailings disrupt ocean flows
items.summary: Vessel attacks near the Strait of Hormuz and carriers blanking roughly 13% of October sailings have pushed global ocean on-time performance down and delayed US-bound containers by nearly a week.
